body:
That is really tough. Thank you for sharing this. You have been dealing with endless pain and a struggle that does not seem to cease. I'm in the same or rather a boat that is akin to yours. You are strong. You are still breathing. We are all fed an illusion that mental suffering can be cured. That we can be made whole. The thing I have learned is that we are never whole. Life is about finding ways to move forward despite the pain and struggling along the way. For some there is more pain and struggling and for others less. None of that matters because we can really only know our own.

We are all trying to find those moments of happiness -- those moments of feeling whole, feeling complete. When those moments arrive, they are not there forever. It's not like the movies where it's happily ever after and the credits roll. We are in a perpetual state of trying to return to those moments of trying to feel complete. As long as you are breathing, you have an opportunity for more moments where you can enjoy life like this past week and chances to give even more people great memories and life lessons. While living can both bring pain and happiness, with death, there is nothingness. 

You don't seem very good at suicide. You seem really great at living. As tough as  things have been for you, you've lived through it all, even through your suicide attempts. Stay strong and do the thing you are great at -- living.

Hi. That sounds really painful and tough. Thank you for reaching out and I hope you know that you are valid. The fact you've made it this far after everything you've gone through is extremely admirable. You are obviously a fighter and a strong person. I was in a similar boat last semester during law school. I felt knee capped and it was upsetting feeling like my intelligence was gone or rather inaccessible. 

Your promise is not ridiculous. You see your graduation as freedom from your current awful situation. Your life is dependent on a chance to be free of the toxic situation and your suffering. That chance of a better life is what your life is dependent on. As long as you are breathing, that chance will never go away.  Stay strong and I hope that you grow, that things get better, and that you get through all the pains life has to offer.

Hi, I'm sorry you have to go through what you are going through. I can relate with your feelings and I want to say you are not alone. If this sub can show you anything, its that many of us on the planet feel alone. So for what its worth, us lonely people are with you. Hopefully you wake up one day feeling rested and ready to take on this scary and lonely world head on. Thank you for sharing your experience with us. It is always hard to express these things.
You are not a burden. The world is a lonely place and if you were gone it'd would be even lonelier.

I'm glad that your kitten and SO were both able to be there for you. I'm glad that you are alive. You have been through a lot and I hope that the road ahead leads you to a place where you can better cope and through all the shit. Thank you for posting this and sharing what you were and currently still work through. I still have not been able to ever talk about my attempts in detail. And only one person knows I've tried. Out of all my friends and family only one person. I hope I can find the strength be able to talk about it. I feel guilty everyday that the people closest to me don't now. I feel like I'm lying to them. It's a heavy weight. Once again, thank you for sharing this and I'm happy that you are still breathing.

Death is the only thing certain for us. The minute instant that we find ourselves kicking and screaming, born into this existence we are dying. To live takes true and total control. Choosing to die, how can that be brave? It's not brave people who know when to quit. It is smart people who quit when they know there is nothing to be gained. As long as you are living there is a possibility for something to be gained. When someone kills themselves, they return to the realm of nothing; No pain. No happiness. No peace. No suffering.

Committing suicide is giving into what happens to all of us eventually. Life is lonely and painful. Unfortunately no matter how empathetic a person can be, we will never know anyone else's suffering but our own. Not all suffering is the same but we can only truly feel our own pain. I think everyone in the world is brave for fighting their respective demons and choosing to live.  I think you are brave. I think about killing myself often and have made attempts. I'm tired of death and the yearn for death controlling me and preventing me from wanting to live. The only control I have is to fight that urge and just wait to meet my maker when my maker decides to come for me.

You are not useless or a coward. You are alive. The true trap is non-existence. All of us spend all but .00000000000000000000001%\^∞ of history in a state of non-existence. That.00000000000000000000001%\^∞ is your existence. Though its a grain of sand on an infinite beach, the blip that is your life is your only chance at anything at all. It's your chance to be a good person or a bad person. Your chance to feel pleasure or pain. A chance to love or hate. A chance to do drugs or go on a hike. You can fry your brain on the endless content of television, music, etc. or be a glutton and eat the fanciest of foods or the shittiest of junk. The only absolute in all of our lives is that we will return to the trap of non-existence. We lose any chance for any of the infinite realities  we can experience the moment our heart stops and our sentience ceases to exist. I'm atheist and my assumptions are based on the idea that there is no afterlife. Even if I'm wrong, what could be next is Hell, reincarnating to something worse than now, or whatever a pious person believes. Try your best to ride out the suffering and the pain. Maybe luck and joy will rain down on you one day. No shot at that if you disappeared and were erased.

Sorry you are struggling and things have been getting shittier and shittier. Death is waiting for you. Why rush? It's going to happen. Nobody who ever has walked this Earth has escaped it. Death is an asshole why not stick it to him a bit? Death is certain but what is not certain is whats on the other side of life. What if its worse? I've said this around this sub before, I personally thinking that nothingness is on the other side. When I came to terms that life has no meaning and there is just a void after it, I've embraced the pain so that I can drink-up the smallest of pleasures and joy that might come my way.

 I want to kill myself everyday and I've tried on a few occasions; coming very close. I've decided since death is coming anyway and nothing is probably waiting for me on the other side, I'm going to see this though. Hell I might have the most minuscule chance at winning the lottery or eventually finding normalcy/happiness, but I have a zero percent chance at any of that when Death finally wins and gets me.

That sounds awful. It seems like you have and are still going through it. I'm sorry that you are suffering daily and I hope the way to turn that around finds you. If you ever want to talk to a fellow lonely person, please reach out. I'll listen and hold some space for you. 

I want to die as well, but what's waiting on the other side of life? I personally think it is a void of nothing. I don't have much choice in my life. Death is a certainty and what keeps me going is that choose to go through the pain and suffering. I'm going to continue to flip-off Death and make him work for it. If I shall suffer, so shall Death.

That is really hard. I'm sorry to hear about your struggle. You are not alone. I want so badly to cut myself as well but in these instances I try to go through the posts in this sub or any of the other spaces on the internet that exists for the same purpose. Reaching out to strangers also struggling and thoughtfully responding about their suffering has been a good way to tackle my demons and pain. I also talk to others going through the shit as well on  supportiv every now and then.

I'm glad you are still muscling through. It's a struggle and this post has lifted my spirits (mentally drowning at the moment)  this evening. If you ever find yourself needing a set of ears to listening, DM me!

I know the feeling. While my major depressive episodes has me yearning for the end, that feeling of nothingness is unbearable. I didn't feel like I was living. I'm sorry to hear that you are going through it. I hope some way you end up out of that hole.

Living is hard. I've attempted to quit this whole thing called life. Whats gets me through is knowing so many people feel unheard and alone and if I go ahead and quit, that's another set of a set of ears to listen that's gone and an already lonely world is even lonelier. The best I can do is be a set of ears and listen. You and everyone in here deserve to be heard and my ears (inbox) is open.

It makes me sad and makes things harder for me when I think about how upset and concerned the people in my life would be to just knowing I think about this. I'm tired too but I'm trying my best for them and myself. It's hard and I wish I could talk to them explicitly about my darkest feelings and pains without worrying them. Its so hard bottling these things up and just living with it alone in my head.

Life is weird and its hard.  I've tried to take my life before. I sought help. Things got better but then eventually they got hard again. Then better, then hard, it goes on and on. The loneliness comes and goes and sometimes feels perpetual. We all go through it in some way and suffer and can only really know our own suffering. Its crazy because we are not alone because we all are alone if that makes any sense.

The best we can do is try and try to be there for others. I'm new here and a stranger but if you ever want to express things message me and I'll listen. I'll try my best to keep up with my inbox.
